training.trainable_parameters: Full-parameter DeepSpeed ZeRO3 BF16 model forward with FP32 optimizer state
training.continuation_optimizer: Both branches reset optimizer and scheduler identically, initialize weights from exact same first-epoch final checkpoint.
training.trajectory_policy: Retain one model trajectory per environment occurrence, including failed/partial outcomes; infrastructure interruption is recovered, not scored as model failure. All final context/summary segments supervised as original training.

probe.reward: official raw score; no binarization; mean-center per question over32rollouts, no std normalization
probe.drop: All0/all1 and any other constant-score question; no replacement questions
probe.average: Arithmetic mean over valid question gradients, no norm weighting
probe.score: dot(g_avg,d_i), full trainable parameters, no projection or preconditioning
probe.no_valid_questions: If all14questions have constant scores, record no usable signal and set guided probabilities uniform; do not invent replacement probes.
probe.parallel_execution: Up to4independent1H200workers, deterministic question load balancing; every worker uses1/global_valid_questions and fullparametergradients; CPU sums partials, no projection. EachGPUworker128GCPU RAM.
probe.forward_precision: BF16 model, matching actual DeepSpeed module.bfloat16(); actualTrainer/LigerCE. Per-row gradients accumulated in FP32 external buffers.
probe.numerical_audit: runs/gradient-precision-check/result.json: legacyFP32autocast differs; new gradient computations use training_bf16.

environment_resampling.zero_variance: Uniform probability if all candidate dots equal

metrics: paired difference with task bootstrap CI
evaluation.note: Probe subset is feedback-used; heldout56 is primary generalization comparison.

environment_runtime.semantics: All728 original Dockerfiles identical; omit COPY seeds during common image build, inject task-specific seeds before agent with byte/mode/root-ownership verification.

pipeline_scheduling: One4H200 inference server at a time; overlap with4H200 training or up to2 single-H200 candidate gradient workers within8GPU bound.
pilot_gate: Only first teacher-batch1 trajectory gates32-way fanout; later phases reuse validated harness and start32-way directly to avoid a long firsttask idling inference.

student_serving_execution.reason: Recover vLLM0.11 illegal GPU memory access; use same vLLM0.32CUDA13stack for probe andbothfinalmodels. No validprobe/finaleval outcomes existed beforechange.

empty_sft_export_policy.scope: Model-budget errors with zero successfully completed LLM calls and no ATIF assistant turns
empty_sft_export_policy.outcome: Keep official score and raw responses; no reroll
empty_sft_export_policy.export: Zero SFT rows; zero gradient contribution; score still enters within-question reward mean
empty_sft_export_policy.reason: Handle observed valid output-length/time-budget outcome without changing frozen Harbor accepted-turn export semantics

historical_policy.storage: Own fixed sandbox ephemeral-storage quota exhaustion during agent execution -> score0, reward_source=model_sandbox_resource_limit if verifier unavailable. Node pressure eviction is not this case.
historical_policy.memory: Container OOMKilled timestamp inside agent_execution interval, original pod UID, explicit memory limit -> model resource-budget failure. OOM after agent ends is not classified this way.

reward_authority.policy: Only numeric rewards actually returned by original verifier are scores. Missing verifier reward remains null, including resource/context-budget and cwd-deletion errors. No inferred zeros or new rollout to replace an unscored original.
reward_authority.probe_eligibility: Require all32 original verifier scores; explicitly exclude an incomplete question without adaptive replacement. Then exclude constant-score questions.
reward_authority.reporting: Report score coverage and mean among verifier-scored trials; count confirmed full passes over attempted tasks with missing-outcome bounds. Paired comparison uses jointly scored tasks and separately reports uncertainty bounds over fixed full subsets.
